Definition: a contemplation; by implication, an utterance
BiblicalUsage: Siach is meditation, and it is also complaint, the same word for the prayer that ponders and the prayer that pours out grief. Hannah speaks out of the abundance of her complaint, Job says he will leave his complaint upon himself and speak in the bitterness of his soul, the psalmist mourns in his complaint, and then the same word turns sweet: my meditation of Him shall be sweet, and I will be glad in the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe meditation and complaint are the same prayer in two weathers. Hannah complained and the psalmist meditated, and I hold that God takes both, because both are honest talk with Him.
